items.source_en:
Daughters of Exile

The earliest Dathomirian records do not begin with conquest or prophecy, but with banishment. Around 600 BBY, a Jedi Knight named Allya was cast out and sent to a world the Order considered lost. She survived not by imposing doctrine, but by adapting it. Her teachings, stripped of hierarchy and shaped by necessity, merged with the customs of those who followed her. Over generations, Allya became more than a founder. She became an ancestor. Her descendants called themselves the Daughters of Allya, and from that lineage the Witches of Dathomir were born.

By the age of the Galactic Empire, Allya’s bloodline had fractured into distinct, female-dominated clans spread across Dathomir’s regions. Each clan enforced its own laws governing the use of the Force, reflecting centuries of divergence rather than unity. Despite their differences, nearly all shared one absolute rule passed down through tradition rather than scripture: never concede to evil. Only the Nightsisters broke from this oath, redefining power and purpose in ways that would mark them as outliers even among their own kind.

[This holobook presents a historical and cultural study of the Witches of Dathomir, tracing their origins to the exile of Jedi Knight Allya and examining how her legacy fractured into rival clans whose interpretations of power shaped the planet’s destiny.]
items.legacy_ko:
망명의 딸들

가장 초기 다소미르 기록은 정복이나 예언이 아니라 추방으로 시작됩니다. 기원전 600년경, 알리아라는 제다이 기사가 추방되어 제다이 기사단이 잃어버렸다고 간주하는 세계로 보내졌습니다. 그녀는 교리를 강요하는 대신 적응함으로써 살아남았습니다. 계급을 배제하고 필요에 의해 형성된 그녀의 가르침은 그녀를 따르는 이들의 관습과 융합되었습니다. 여러 세대를 거치며 알리아는 단순한 창시자 이상이 되었습니다. 그녀는 조상이 되었습니다. 그녀의 후손들은 스스로를 알리아의 딸들이라 불렀고, 그 혈통에서 다소미르의 마녀들이 탄생했습니다.

은하 제국 시대에 이르러 알리아의 혈통은 다소미르 전역에 퍼진 여성 중심의 개별 클랜으로 분열되었습니다. 각 클랜은 포스 사용에 관한 자체적인 법을 시행했으며, 이는 통일성보다는 수 세기에 걸친 분화를 반영했습니다. 차이점에도 불구하고, 거의 모든 클랜은 경전이 아닌 전통을 통해 전해지는 절대적인 규칙을 공유했습니다. 바로 악에 굴복하지 말라는 것입니다. 오직 나이트시스터만이 이 맹세에서 벗어나, 동족들 사이에서도 이단자로 낙인찍힐 방식으로 힘과 목적을 재정의했습니다.

[이 홀로북은 다소미르 마녀들의 기원을 제다이 기사 알리아의 추방으로 추적하고, 그녀의 유산이 어떻게 행성의 운명을 결정짓는 힘의 해석을 가진 경쟁 클랜으로 분열되었는지 검토하는 역사적, 문화적 연구를 제시합니다.]

locations.vanilla_source_en:
Charity in a Godless Universe

Amelia Sang

Part II:

My settlement was founded as a commune by the members of my family's church: a place where the congregation could worship in peace, without interference. 

But word travels fast, and our small colony began to grow. Our success attracted those in need of help, and those with nowhere else to turn.

When I was 10 years old, I watched two officers lead a frail-looking man down our street. He had been stealing from our settlement's emergency rations. Our local security had been trying to catch the thief for weeks.

I asked my parents if the man was hungry. If he didn't have enough to eat, couldn't we feed him the same food he had been stealing?

My parents explained that while our settlement probably could afford to feed the man, stealing is a sin, and the thief must ask God for forgiveness. That night, my family gathered to pray for the soul of the man. They asked God to help him see beyond a life of sin. 

That man's name was Edgar, and he didn't need our prayers. Edgar needed food, and work. Since no one gave him either, Edgar would be in and out of our settlement's prison for several years to come.

The most important thing is choosing the right successor. And I just know Leon could do it. I have failed him so much. The job always seemed so pressing. If I'm brutally honest with myself, the nannies and the boarding schools raised him more than I. But there is greatness in him, if only he could see it.

I'm going to talk with my lawyer first thing when I get in system. The wheels need to be set in motion. I'm having a good day today. I feel so normal. But I'm walking through the whole world like it's a cloud.

items.source_en:
Today marks the start of a new adventure in neuroscience. Although SyntheTech Industries is still waiting for official approval, we're moving forward with testing their latest technology: an Internal Neuroamp. I can't tell you how excited I am to be on a new project and have a chance to regain some admiration among my colleagues. 

I've invited Sean to come work with me on the project since he's familiar with how I operate. Plus, like myself, I knew he could really use the credits. These procedures should be quick and simple, so it's really a matter of SyntheTech Industries's tech playing nicely with brain tissue. Dr. Faye Sengsavahn is the creator of this new neuroamp and she's assured me smooth sailing. Let's just hope with our combined expertise we find success. This could be the boost my career needs.
items.legacy_ko:
오늘은 신경과학 분야의 새로운 모험이 시작되는 날이다. 신테크 인더스트리에서 아직 공식 승인을 기다리는 중이지만, 우리는 그들의 최신 기술인 내부 뉴로앰프 테스트를 진행하기로 했다. 새로운 프로젝트에 참여하게 되어 동료들 사이에서 다시 인정받을 기회를 얻게 된 것이 얼마나 기쁜지 모른다.

items.source_en:
There's an old Swedish proverb which says luck never gives; it only lends.

So when I drew straws with Gutierrez over who was going to do fix the exterior, I wouldn't say I was given a break. I was just lent a little more time.

Besides, Gutierrez was the better choice. He's always been the brave one. He tried to fight the Collective when they boarded, and lost a tooth in the scuffle. Me, I hid in a corner. I've got a mouth full of teeth and all they do is chatter.

When the vote came over whether to consume the body, I cast my vote in favor. We needed the energy, and here was our lucky break. But while I felt good at first, I couldn't keep any of the meat down.  

Gutierrez told me I was lucky, and at the time, I agreed. But I was only borrowing it you see, it was never mine to keep.
items.legacy_ko:
행운은 결코 주는 것이 아니라 빌려주는 것뿐이라는 오래된 스웨덴 속담이 있다.

그래서 구티에레스와 외부 수리를 누가 할지 제비뽑기를 했을 때, 난 운이 좋았다고 말할 수 없었다. 그저 시간을 조금 더 빌렸을 뿐이니까.

게다가 구티에레스가 더 나은 선택이었다. 그는 항상 용감한 친구였지. 놈들이 난입했을 때 맞서 싸우다가 이빨 하나를 잃기도 했으니까. 난 구석에 숨어 있었지. 내 입안 가득한 이빨들은 그저 덜덜 떨리기만 할 뿐이었어.

시신을 먹을지 말지 투표했을 때, 난 찬성표를 던졌다. 에너지가 필요했고, 그게 우리에게 찾아온 행운이었으니까. 하지만 처음엔 괜찮을 줄 알았는데, 고기를 도저히 삼킬 수가 없더군.

구티에레스는 내게 운이 좋다고 말했고, 그때는 나도 동의했다. 하지만 난 그저 잠시 빌렸을 뿐이었어. 애초에 내 것이 아니었던 거지.

items.source_en:
My crew hates me. They think I'm unqualified, and I don't know what I'm doing.

The worst part is, they might be right.

I don't know how I became First Mate of this ship at twenty-five. I think Captain Oswalt was trying to pick a younger successor, knowing he wasn't retiring anytime soon. 

But then he fell ill, and everything's gone to hell. I'm in over my head and the crew knows it. But at the same time, I feel like I owe it to the Captain to prove he was right. And while he has the experience, I know for a fact he didn't want Thybulle to be Captain. He's too much of an asshole. I may not know much, but I know people.

But I need to convince the rest of the crew I'm the right choice. Right now, only Dr. Guentzel and the droids listen to me.
items.legacy_ko:
승무원들이 나를 증오한다. 내가 자격 미달이며 뭘 해야 할지도 모른다고 생각한다.

가장 최악인 건, 그 말이 맞을지도 모른다는 점이다.

스물다섯 살인 내가 어떻게 이 배의 일등 항해사가 되었는지 모르겠다. 오스왈트 선장님이 당장 은퇴할 생각은 없으면서도 젊은 후계자를 뽑으려 했던 것 같다.

하지만 그분이 병석에 눕게 되면서 모든 게 엉망이 되었다. 내 능력 밖의 일이라는 걸 승무원들도 안다. 하지만 동시에, 선장님이 옳았다는 걸 증명해야 한다는 책임감을 느낀다. 그분은 경험이 풍부하셨지만, 티불이 선장이 되는 건 절대 원치 않으셨다는 걸 확실히 안다. 그놈은 너무나도 쓰레기 같은 인간이니까. 내가 아는 건 별로 없어도, 사람 보는 눈은 있다.

하지만 승무원들에게 내가 적임자라는 걸 설득해야 한다. 지금은 귄첼 박사님과 드로이드들만이 내 말을 듣는다.
